changelog: Dashboard: a TUN card shows the current state and toggles it without opening Settings
TUN: heartbeat, fake-ip saver, egress monitor and the event pump now exit with TUN (no heartbeat lines after disabling)
TUN: the adapter is reopened when it exists and uses a stable GUID, so toggling no longer creates SSLProxy 2, 3, ...
TUN: leftover adapters (SSLProxy, -1 ... -4, suffixed SSLProxy 2, 3 ... and SSLProxy Tunnel Tunnel) are removed on startup (wintun devices only)
